description: This file defines the class SugarURIFilter, which extends the HTMLPurifier_URIFilter class. It implements URL filtering logic to allow only trusted resource URLs in the SuiteCRM application, mainly for security purposes such as preventing CSRF attacks. The filter uses a list of trusted domains from configuration and applies rules to permit or deny URLs based on schemes, hostnames, query parameters, and paths.

classes.name: URIFilter
classes.description: A URL filter class for suite CRM's email security, allowing only URLs from trusted domains and safe patterns.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with trusted domains from configuration settings.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines whether a given URL should be allowed or blocked based on security rules and trusted domains.
